d:
Hi all.

I wrote this little story, and generated the imaged with AI.

Usually TG MTF stories start with a guy that dresses like a girl, and then transforms his body. I wanted to see something different, but I did not found much stories like that, so I tried to write on story of my own.

So I tried to write one. But I don't have much time to spend on that, and the budget I had on the AI front for the images was limited. So I could not generate an illimited amount of images. And it was my first time playing witg generative AI.

So I tried to make sure characters are coherent, that you can see who is who, but you can find some inconsistency from frame to frame.

Anyway, I hop you like the story I wrote. I tried to make it quite sweet. And I tried to keep the persona of the main character as much as possible between beginning and end.

I hope you will like it, and if so maybe I will write a (proper) longer version, but probably as a novel.
